# Awesome MCP

A curated directory of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers maintained by WunderCorp. Browse a category to see its servers and project links.

## Submit an MCP server

Add or update one `servers/<category>/<slug>/server.json` per pull request. The category pages are generated from this metadata; do not edit generated Markdown in new submissions.

See [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [MCP server template](templates/server.json).

```bash
node scripts/validate-catalog.mjs
node scripts/validate-taxonomy.mjs
node scripts/generate-readme.mjs
```

## Review and safety

Directory inclusion is not a security certification. Safety review is a separate, point-in-time process; unscanned listings have not been verified safe.
